settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your experience
settings.saveHintGeneral: Theme & toggles apply instantly; other changes apply after saving
settings.saveHintOther: Changes apply after saving, across the whole settings page
downloads.heading: Download settings
downloads.dirNote: Leave empty to use the system default download folder; pick from history.
downloads.classifyHint: Archive by category folder; extensions separated by comma, semicolon or space
downloads.addCatHint: Separate multiple extensions with comma/semicolon/space, e.g. mp4, mkv; avi; rmvb. When one extension belongs to multiple categories, the last saved wins.
network.heading: Multi-NIC splitting
network.nicsHint: Primary NIC always participates; select more connected NICs to accelerate in parallel
network.weightHint: Weights auto-allocated as (NIC count + 1) shares: primary gets 2, others 1 each (e.g. 3 NICs → 50% / 25% / 25%). The picker only selects participating NICs; changes apply globally after saving and apply to new downloads.
network.daemonOff: Daemon not connected, cannot enumerate NICs
proxy.heading: Proxy settings
proxy.modeHint: Direct by default; system proxy follows env vars (Windows system settings must be entered manually as custom)
proxy.savedApplied: Saved; new downloads will use this proxy
proxy.note: BT/DHT proxy supported in a later version; proxy currently applies only to HTTP(S) downloads (same path for probing and chunk requests).
general.heading: General settings
general.autoStartHint: Auto-start this app on system login
general.notifyHint: Send a system notification when a task completes
about.heading: About
accounts.heading: Account binding
accounts.sub: Manage bound external accounts; binding unlocks the related feature
accounts.tgNotBound: Not bound — log in to access Telegram channels
accounts.nationalOnly: Enter local number only; area code selected on the left
accounts.passwordHint: Two-step verification enabled; enter password to continue
accounts.note: Account data is stored locally only. Telegram uses a standalone orig-tg service that must be launched by Tauri.
accounts.diagDesc: Inspect orig-tg service status and logs to troubleshoot login/code failures
accounts.tgUnavailableHint: orig-tg could not reach Telegram, so sending codes and signing in will fail. See Connection diagnostics below for the reason.
accounts.tgUnreachableHint: orig-tg is not running, so the sign-in state cannot be confirmed. Start the service and retry.
accounts.diagFail: Cannot reach diagnostics API; make sure orig-tg is running
tg.toggleHint: When enabled, daemon launches orig-tg with the main proxy injected; disabling stops it and hides the TG module
tg.heading: Telegram Channels
tg.selectChannel: Select a channel on the left to view media
tg.notMonitored: This channel is not monitored yet; add it to auto-archive new content
tg.protectedMedia: Protected or access denied; cannot cache. Try online playback.
tg.cacheFailed: Caching failed. Retry, or play it online instead.
tg.noStored: No stored media yet; click “Sync now” to pull new content
tg.clearCacheHint: Clear loaded thumbnails and temporary media cache to free disk space
tg.clearCacheConfirm: Clear TG cache? Loaded thumbnails and temporary media will reload.
tg.selectGroup: Select a group on the left
tg.historyEmpty: No media in this channel yet
tg.monitorViewHint: Local monitor list; cached content stays readable offline
tg.monitorEmpty: No monitored channels yet. Toggle a switch in a group below.
tg.emptyCached: No cached items yet. Monitored content is indexed automatically for caching.
tg.serviceOffline: TG service is offline. Start the APP or sign in to browse the media library.
tg.selectToPlay: Select an item on the left to play
tg.downloadDirTip: Where cached files are saved. Applies immediately (new caches only).
tg.decodeFail: This format (e.g. .mov/QuickTime) cannot be decoded by the browser. Open it with the system player inside the APP
tg.setupTip: One-time setup: create an app at my.telegram.org → API development tools, then enter the api_id and api_hash below. The app stores the config and starts the service automatically afterwards.
tg.unavailableHint: orig-tg could not reach Telegram, so sending codes and signing in will fail. Open Settings → Accounts for the reason.
tg.unreachableHint: orig-tg is not running, so the sign-in state cannot be confirmed. Start it from Settings → Accounts and retry.
error.boundaryDesc: The TG panel failed to render. Retry or check the TG service.
media.title: Library
media.emptyHint: Use “Import folder” to index a local video/photo directory. Files stay where they are — nothing is copied or moved.
media.showing: Showing {n} / {total} — use search or filters to narrow down
media.confirmRemoveItemsHint: Removes the selected entries (tags and series links included). Original files on disk are NOT deleted.
media.confirmDeleteSeriesHint: Deletes the series and its episode list. The media entries themselves stay in the library as unassigned items.
